laws: No executor identity, device, provider, or machine is canonical authority.
Executors are disposable transports for a content-addressed verification capsule.
Admission requires status AVAILABLE, exact platform compatibility when required, incremental_spend_usd == 0, and hard_zero_spend == true.
If no executor is admissible, terminalize as EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE; never silently create billable infrastructure.
Platform-specific proof is a scoped certification requirement and must not globally block platform-neutral work.
GPU and heavy-compute use are forbidden unless the capsule explicitly permits them.

Every executor selection requires a current PROJECT_BRAIN_CONTINUOUS_OBS_CONTEXT_V1 bound to live canonical state and all material world/dependency evidence; UNKNOWN, stale, failed, or contradictory material state fails closed before executor admission.
